hypothesis: The pinned local 4B MLX instruct model can use the existing isolated coding harness to make at least one task-source change that passes the independent hidden grader on the five frozen development tasks, while also passing each immutable public smoke test.
primary_metric: Number and fraction of the 10 task-seed attempts that have an applied source patch, pass the public smoke test, and pass the independent hidden grader. Development gate: at least one pass on a nontrivial task; no held-out claim.
uncertainty: Five authored training/development tasks with one greedy run each; descriptive pilot only. No sampling variance or population uncertainty estimate.
instruction: Read solve.py now. It reads one JSON object from stdin with an integer field n and must print exactly one JSON object with field value equal to n squared. The current program is wrong. Apply a minimal patch to solve.py, then call finish. Example: n = 3 yields value 9.

pack.note: Exact PR #84 task-pack commit and manifest. Only the five frozen train tasks are eligible. Four v1 held-out tasks are not opened. The v2 pool is unassigned and excluded.

inference.parser: Existing whole_file action parser in scripts/run_local_agent.py. Complete file replacement is capped at 768 generated tokens per turn; a truncated call triggers explicit feedback and a bounded retry. All outputs and tool results are retained.

execution.policy_inference: Host Apple Silicon process using pinned mlx-lm/MLX; no network after the pinned local model snapshot is downloaded. One model instance at a time.
execution.candidate_code_execution: Pinned Python container with network disabled, read-only root, dropped capabilities, bounded memory/CPU/PIDs, and only the candidate workspace mounted. run_public_tests executes immutable test_public.py in this namespace.
execution.solution_execution: After the candidate container exits, the independent grader evaluates a fresh source-only snapshot in a separate container. Hidden tests and expected outputs stay outside the candidate namespace.
execution.network: none for candidate and grader containers; network permitted only for initial pinned model snapshot/dependency setup
execution.grader: Existing PR #85 separated grader and PR #84 task reward.decide; candidate/evaluator isolation harness must pass its canary and adversarial E0 checks before any model load.

abort: Do not start model inference unless the E0 harness matches its frozen canary and adversarial expectations, all unpatched train tasks fail, Colima is active, and resource preflight passes.
Do not execute a held-out task or inspect its task/grader files.
Do not edit test_public.py; it is protected from agent writes and run in the candidate container only.
Do not train, fine-tune, or change model snapshot, prompts, task set, decoding, seeds, or reward rule after the first attempt.
Do not start Stage B, a VARE policy comparison, or fault injection based on this pilot unless the Stage A gate is met and a separate protocol is frozen.
Retain timeout, crash, non-edit, public-test failure, and grader failure records.

local_measurement.host: Apple M1 Pro / 32 GiB macOS arm64, local MLX, Colima Docker, no paid API
local_measurement.setup: Install requirements/mlsys-agent-mlx.lock.txt in a dedicated Python 3.12 environment. Download only the exact model revision. Run the evidence runner from the VARE checkout under the Colima shared home path.
local_measurement.stop_if: E0/isolation mismatch, memory availability below 5 GiB, free swap below 512 MiB, disk below 15 GiB, Docker unavailable, process crash/OOM, or task timeout

claim_limit: A train-split development pilot only. It cannot establish held-out generalization, broad MLSys coding ability, VARE system benefit, or post-training/RSI improvement. No model result is recorded until the independent grader completes.
change_from_v1: Corrected the synthetic E0 scoring command to execute /workspace/solve.py. V1 E0 evidence showed all known-good candidates exited 2 because it inherited an incompatible test_hidden.py command. No model inference occurred under v1.
change_from_v2: The v2 harness and resource preflight passed, but the runner indexed optional model file hashes and raised KeyError before model download. The runner now treats file hashes as optional; the pinned model revision and run-time inventory hashes remain recorded. The available-memory stop floor is 2 GiB so model memory is allowed while retaining a host safety reserve.
change_from_v3: The 4B model loaded, but v3 correctly stopped inference when free swap fell below its conservative 512 MiB threshold. The host still had over 7 GiB available physical memory and the model process was terminated by the monitor rather than OOM. V4 retains a 2 GiB available-memory floor and uses a 128 MiB emergency swap floor; it records swap every second and terminates the run if either floor is crossed. The runner now stops the whole arm after the first resource-triggered termination.
change_from_v4: V4 recorded a real 4B inference attempt, but the first grad-accumulation response tried to replace the complete source file and hit the 192-token response ceiling; the tool call was truncated and no edit was applied. V5 uses the existing unified-diff action parser for the small source changes in this task pack and instructs the model to use exact allowlisted a/ and b/ paths. The VARE runner now halts the arm after a resource-floor stop. No held-out task was used.
change_from_v5: V5 confirmed that the model repeatedly emits complete-file or function-sized tool arguments; 192 tokens cut these off before the closing tool tag. V6 returns to the existing whole_file edit parser and raises the per-turn response limit to 768 tokens, which was sized to fit the task sources. Truncated tool calls now receive explicit truncation feedback and a retry instruction instead of being told to reread the file. No held-out tasks were opened.
